subject: app-rdef
title: APP.RDEF.------P.PROG.
description: Chart on book p. 69 (SD(SY)-47). APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; P-PROG (particular progressionalism) is the partner. From the subject: POL-P (political policies) and RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From RT-ALGN: W-DY. From W-DY: CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions). CUL-INFO-F is on a dotted line from W-DY. From CRTF-D: IST-F (isolated focus). INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) is on a dotted line from IST-F.
